operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S12. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S12_entry_watchlist: S12 must not assume invariant mastery; S11 still conflates construction validation with lifecycle preservation and mutable ClientRecord can violate validated rules after creation.
S12 must not assume dataclass/type hints enforce runtime types. API/SQL adapters need explicit parsing/validation at the boundary.
S12 repositories/adapters must not treat @runtime_checkable Protocol isinstance as signature/type validation; Python only performs a shallow presence check.
S12 must reuse one canonical domain model. S11 repeatedly redefined ClientRecord and RelationshipEvidence with weaker or absent invariants.
S12 serialization/database mapping must explicitly choose DTO/mapper boundaries because S11 prose says mapping lives at the boundary while code puts to_dict on the entity.
Transaction amount/currency contract remains non-creditable: opening says non-negative, T1-B says positive, and no canonical Transaction class exists in theory.
Properties/frozen do not provide authorization or deep immutability; do not expose raw sensitive fields under that assumption.
Composition is PARTIAL, while basic class-vs-instance and dataclass default_factory are the only new S11 concepts safe to credit as USABLE.
CP-N1-C/CASO internal identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless expanded globally.
